Get improve directory (internal implementation)

getImproveDir.Rd

Get improve directory (internal implementation)

Usage

getImproveDir(
  env_var,
  subdir,
  windows_base = "LOCALAPPDATA",
  unix_hidden = TRUE
)

Arguments

env_var

Environment variable name to check first

subdir

Subdirectory name for defaults

windows_base

Base directory for Windows (e.g., "LOCALAPPDATA", "USERPROFILE")

unix_hidden

Whether to use hidden directory on Unix (prefix with .)

Value

Character string with path to directory
